module: Style settings of the editor's spline tools: 3D colors (cursor, nodes, junctions, splines, handles, preview wires) for debug drawing, and ImGui color palettes per theme. The available themes are blueRose, vapourStatic, canyonClay, terminalAurora, summerOfLove, deerPark, dreamMachine, headlights, crystal (default) and neoIndustrial.
notes: getStyle() builds a new table on each call (color(r,g,b,a) 0-255 for rendering, ImVec4 0-1 for ImGui).
getImguiCols returns the 'crystal' palette for an unknown or nil theme.

getStyle.desc: Returns the interface style properties: colors of cursor, nodes, junctions, splines (selected, faded, linked), handles, preview wires, and a few ImVec4 (greenD, blueB, blueD, redB, yellowB).

getImguiCols.desc: Returns the ImGui color palette of the requested theme.
